approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
first_installment_sketch: 'An Agent Said Success. Nothing Happened.' (directive sec 39, series item 1): one model proposal such as 'I should follow this account' walked through the deterministic check list, ending with independent observation verifying the effect. No invented run; the chain itself is the directive's worked example.
inputs: one model output that claims a consequential action
the deterministic checks that stand between proposal and execution
name: AGENT OUTPUT != AUTHORITY
outputs: one major-position post per proposal type
a repeatable separation diagram: model reasons, runtime authorizes, adapter executes, observation verifies
purpose: Make 'agent output is not authority' a major PING position by showing the deterministic machinery between a model proposal and any executed effect.
template: Model proposal at the top (e.g. 'I should follow this account'). PING answers: that is a proposal. Then the deterministic checklist: Is this the correct principal? Is the target resolved? Does the account control exist? Is the capability granted? Inside policy? Inside budget? Duplicate? Already pending? State known? Provider supports it? Only then execution. Close with the separation: The model reasons. The runtime authorizes. The adapter executes. Independent observation verifies. This separation appears in every technical narrative.
